282749378.description:
Vintage Hemingray-42 Aqua Glass Telephone Pole Insulator w/ Iron Peg
Vintage Hemingray glass telegraph/telephone pole insulator in aqua/teal blue color. Features embossed 'HEMINGRAY-42' lettering and beaded skirt design around the base. Includes original wrought iron pole mounting peg/pin with wood-covered threaded shaft, used to attach the insulator to utility poles. Both pieces show age-appropriate wear consistent with antique railroad/telegraph line hardware, including surface rust on the iron peg and natural glass wear with embedded dirt. Authentic antique collectible pairing a Hemingray glass insulator with its matching iron pin. Popular among insulator and telegraphiana collectors.
10 x 4 x 4 in

282946598.description:
Vintage Bent-Stem Tobacco Pipe Light Brown Wood Brass Band Scrollwork
Vintage tobacco smoking pipe with a bent-stem design and bulbous bowl made of light brown wood, likely briar. The bowl and shank feature ornate embossed brass or gold-tone metal banding with scrollwork and floral motifs. The black stem is curved with a bit end, possibly made of vulcanite or horn. The pipe shows signs of age and use including wear on the finish, darkened areas inside the bowl rim, and residue or wear marks on the metal band and stem joint area. No visible brand markings are present, indicating it may be an unmarked or antique estate pipe. 5.5x1.5

282472086.description:
Lilla Clasica Handmade Tobacco Pipe
Hand-Carved Wooden Pipe with Decorative Accents
Wood, Feathers, and Beads, Approximately 16 Inches Long
A fine hand-made tobacco pipe from the Lilla Clasica collection, featuring a long, elegant churchwarden-style silhouette. This piece combines traditional woodworking with ornamental indigenous-inspired aesthetics, making it a striking display piece or a unique addition to a pipe collection. The pipe is presented in its original satin-lined gift box, highlighting its status as a crafted specialty item.
Hand-carved wooden bowl with a textured, scale-like pattern and deep polished finish
Extra-long wooden stem terminating in a black tapered mouthpiece
Decorative cord wrap adorned with natural-toned beads and dark brown feathers
Includes original maroon presentation box with a gold-tone brand logo and yellow satin lining
Approximately 16 inches in total length
Condition:
The pipe is in excellent condition and appears unsmoked, with no residue or charring inside the bowl. The wood finish remains bright and glossy across both the bowl and stem. Decorative feathers and beads are fully intact and securely attached. The presentation box is structurally sound with minor shelf wear on the exterior; the interior lining is clean and vibrant.
